findings: The finite q/(24 ell) static anomaly is established MMP physics; the proper-clock derivation reproduces it with derivative-controlled cutoff errors.
Yang and Blommaert et al. do not supply the missing transparent gluing action.
An isolated-patch moving-boundary Weyl cocycle has cutoff-suppressed inertia, but its coefficient is not the physical clock mass.
